{{Top|leg}}
The '''School of Starship Engineering''' was an educational facility under the umbrella of [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]]. [[Fia (engineer)|Fia]] graduated from the school several months before the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one of the leading instructors of the School of Starship Engineering lost a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] on a recreational wilderness trip when she encountered dangerous creatures. As the datapad contained irreplaceable information about a new starship design, the school secured funding for an expedition to the creatures' lair on the pretext of studying the death modes of these animals. They hired a freelance [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to travel to the lair, kill the creatures and retrieve the datapad.<ref name="SWG:SADM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Study Animal Death Modes}} on Corellia</ref>
